specific_difference_description: PAPER_OVL1 breaker RON=0.001 ohm is the only scoped compiled closed-state addition. With E_28_29_1 RXB specified per metre and length 0.001 m, RON equals about 60.0% of line R and 5.54% of |Z|, increasing |Z| about 0.663%.
evidence_strength: high for quantity, uniqueness within scoped physical diffs, and pre-fault flow correlation; insufficient to prove sole causality for meshed-network flow and DFIG fault-voltage changes
recommended_next_step: Obtain PSCAD breaker minimum-RON/numerical-stability evidence and an offline compiled-network sensitivity or equivalent calculation showing whether reducing only PAPER RON can restore Stage4 closed-state behavior while preserving switching. Do not edit or Run yet.
paper_sequence_implication: Stage9 remains a validated line-first-trip protection subchain, not a DFIG-before-line-trip paper-like chain.
claim_boundary: No PNNL thermal-rating, protection-setting, coordination, second-trip, natural-cascade, or strict-paper-reproduction claim.
